articles.title: Commercial International Bank (Egypt) S.A.E. Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
articles.summary: Commercial International Bank (Egypt) S.A.E. (LON:CBKD) reported net income of EGP 63.1 billion for the first nine months of 2026, up 2% year over year, as deposit and loan growth helped offset pressure on lending margins.
